types.BinaryTree: a binary tree whose entries have type A, made with make_tree and make_empty_tree

curve.note: A curve is a function from a number between 0 and 1 to a Point: Callable[[float], Point]. A transformation of curves is a function from a curve to a curve. The 2D drawers (draw_connected, ...) and the 3D drawers (draw_3D_connected, ...) are different types: animate_curve takes a 2D drawer and animate_3D_curve a 3D drawer.

types.Point: a point of a curve, with an x and a y, and a z and a colour in 3D
types.CurveDrawn: a curve that was drawn with a 2D drawer
types.Curve3DDrawn: a curve that was drawn with a 3D drawer

matrix.note: get_matrix gives the rows of the tone matrix as a linked list, the bottom row first; each row is a linked list of booleans.

repeat.note: The function that is repeated has the same type for its parameter and its result. The count n must be a whole number.

types.Rune: a picture that you can combine and transform
types.AnimatedRune: an animation of runes, which animate_rune and animate_anaglyph give (no function of rune takes one)

scrabble.note: scrabble_words is an array of the words; scrabble_letters has, for each word, the array of its letters. The tiny versions have far fewer words.

sound.note: A wave is a function from a time in seconds to an amplitude between -1 and 1: Callable[[float], float]. A transformation of sounds is a function from a sound to a sound. record gives a function that stops the recording and gives a function that gives the sound; record_for gives a function that gives the sound.

types.Sound: a sound, which you can play and combine; make_sound makes one from a wave and a duration, and get_wave and get_duration take it apart
